parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource to which the tag belongs.

- If you set ResourceType to Instance, set this parameter to the ID of the dataset acceleration instance. For more information about how to obtain the instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~467899~~).

- If you set ResourceType to Slot, set this parameter to the ID of the dataset acceleration slot. For more information about how to obtain the slot ID, see [ListSlots](~~467905~~).
